_comment: Mannequin body-geometry profiles keyed by sha256 of the source GLB bytes (spec FR 14). Rendered A_TPose, facing s, elevation 45, at res 704 with the drive camera (ortho 3.0); body_h and floor_y are pixel values at that resolution and the body keeps its pixel size at larger canvases (drive rule), with the floor line shifted by (canvas-704)//2.
